sourceClaims.claim: Table Cell contains 49 source variants with 50px ordinary cell geometry
Table composes source cells into domain examples without defining sorting or selection behavior
the public primitive preserves native table markup and leaves data operations to consumers

evidence.source-integrity: pass: raw Table Cell and Table remain unchanged and source axes are checked independently of old snapshots
evidence.structural-contract: pass: every public Table root is classified and native table sections and scoped headings are asserted
evidence.runtime-browser: not-applicable: Table ships no sorting, filtering, pagination, selection, loading or data controller
evidence.accessibility: pass: captions, native sections, scoped headers and unmodified cell semantics are verified in executable consumers
evidence.focused-visual: pass: computed 50px geometry, divider, numeric alignment and real row-hover paint are asserted
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Data Workspace composes Table while application code owns filtering, sorting, selection and empty data
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: a narrow viewport proves horizontal overflow belongs to the Table wrapper while the table remains wider

staticVisual: pass: source and diagnostic pressed/typing cells remain static visual evidence only
realInteractionVisual: pass: locator.hover() on a real body row produces the source-backed muted row paint
runtimeBehavior: not-applicable: row hover changes paint only; nested controls and application data operations retain their own ownership

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: real row hover, nested focus visibility, long text, numeric alignment and narrow wrapper overflow inspected

knownLimitations: responsive cards, sticky headers, resizing, virtualization and data operations are unsupported or consumer-owned
